name: LEAD Design System
description: Design tokens for LEAD, a leadership consultancy for founder led agencies.

ink.description: Primary. Headlines, body text on light, dark bands, footers.

ink-deep.description: Hover and pressed states on ink surfaces.

ink-body.description: Body copy. Softer than the headline colour.

ink-muted.description: Captions, labels, secondary text. Passes AA on canvas.

accent.description: Accent only. Primary buttons, highlights, key numbers. Never body text.

accent-text.description: The only orange safe for text. 5.2 to 1 on canvas.

cream.description: Warmth. Quiet surfaces, tags, cards on dark.

canvas.description: Default page background. Never pure white.

colorUsage.ratio: 60 percent light (canvas and cream), 30 percent ink, 10 percent accent
rules: One accent element per view, usually the call to action.
Never set paragraphs in accent. Use accent-text if orange type is unavoidable.
Never put white text on accent below 24px.
No gradients. Flat colour, with the warm glow as the single exception.
No corporate blue, no purple, no pure black.

typographyRules: One family across everything. Montserrat only.
Headlines all caps in Black or Bold. Body sentence case in Regular or Medium.
Body measure stays between 60 and 75 characters.
Left align by default. Never justify. Never letter space body copy.

radius.usage: 8px on buttons and inputs, 16px on cards and images, full on tags and pills, 0 on full bleed bands.

shadow.usage: Warm and soft, never black. Two levels only.

signatureDevices: Dot grid: 22px spacing, ink at 13 percent opacity, behind heroes and dark bands.
Highlighter: solid accent block or 9px underline swipe behind the single most important phrase. One per screen.
Big number: Black weight, ink numeral with accent unit. One per section.
Warm glow: soft accent halo behind portraits on ink. Never behind text.
Proof row: client marks in ink at 55 percent opacity, one quiet line under the hero.

rules: Short sentences. One idea per line. Line breaks over commas.
Plain verbs and concrete nouns. Name the outcome.
No em dashes anywhere. Use full stops, commas or brackets.
No emojis, no exclamation marks, no hype language.
No false urgency, no countdowns, no fake scarcity.
Buttons say what happens: Book a call, Send the toolkit, Start the audit.
Errors explain the fix in one sentence and never apologise.
